must_fix.title: Plaintext password storage in users.password
must_fix.evidence: spec §3.2 stores password as VARCHAR(255) plain; auth/login.py:42 hashes nothing on insert
must_fix.replacement: store argon2id hash via passlib; migrate existing rows in a one-shot backfill behind a feature flag

must_fix.title: Migration takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users (50M rows, ~14 min)
must_fix.evidence: spec §5.1 ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN shard_key INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; users row-count from conventions.architecture
must_fix.replacement: split into two transactions via pg_repack OR feature-flag dual-write window; either keeps writes online

should_fix.title: Brute-force protection on /login depends on absent WAF
should_fix.evidence: spec §3.4 says rate-limit will live at the edge; conventions.architecture lists no WAF in the stack
should_fix.replacement: add app-level rate-limit (e.g. 5 req/min per IP via Redis counter) until WAF lands

decisions.question: When to run the migration: maintenance window vs blue-green dual-write?

options.label: 30-min Sunday maintenance window
options.consequence: 503 for 30 min; simple rollback; well within SLA 99.5% (3.6 h/month)

options.label: Blue-green dual-write for 2 weeks
options.consequence: no downtime; +$1.8k infra; split-brain risk on rollback if either side diverges

decisions.tradeoff: Operational complexity + cost vs UX and rollback risk.
decisions.rationale: Brief explicitly names cost-conscious as a success criterion; 30-min downtime fits stated SLA.
